nina: FYI intermittent hang with python SDK async streaming when backend sends a final newline-only SSE chunk then closes. Generator sometimes never finishes so cancellation blocks.

nina: Tiny repro: 
```py
agen = client.stream_generate(model=\"mini\")
async for part in agen:
    if part.get(\"eof\"):
        break
```

nina: Env: py3.11, redwood-py 0.9.3, aiohttp transport, nginx ingress. More likely under bursty load.

raj: Sounds like parser isn't treating EOF (zero-length read) as end-of-event. We wait for explicit empty-line delim.

lee: Users report agen.aclose() hanging and task.cancel() leaving sockets referenced.

nina: Workaround: wrap iteration with asyncio.wait_for and call agen.aclose() in finally. Ugly but works.

raj: Quick fix: treat EOF as empty-line and emit final event. Also add tests for: final chunk is "\\n"+FIN and final read returns b'' with no newline.

lee: Longer term: expose a public Stream object with cancel()/close() for both sync and async so users can force-close without relying on generator semantics (RDW-STREAMS-5).

ops-bot: CI: test_stream_cancel flaky on linux-aio (FAILED)  rerun queued.

nina: I'll validate the EOF-as-empty-line patch against our ingress once it's up.
